name: Ramesh Chauhan
profile: Indian beverage entrepreneur (b. 1940) of the Parle family. Parle bought the Bisleri brand from an Italian entrepreneur in 1969 and he built it into India's dominant bottled-water brand; he also created Thums Up, Limca, Gold Spot and Maaza, sold to Coca-Cola in 1993. After talks to sell Bisleri to Tata Consumer ended in 2023, daughter Jayanti (Vice Chairperson) and CEO Angelo George run it.
interesting_fact: After Coca-Cola left India in 1977 he launched Thums Up and built it into India's leading cola; Coca-Cola later bought Parle's soft-drink brands (Thums Up, Limca, Gold Spot, Maaza, Citra) in 1993.
deep_cut_fact: Known as 'RJC' to friends, he holds a double major in mechanical engineering and business management from MIT, returned home at 22, and introduced bottled mineral water to India at 27. His 2013 biography 'Thunder Unbottled, From Thums Up to Bisleri' was written by friend and ex-Newsweek UN bureau chief Patricia J Sethi.

public_contacts.value: wecare@bisleri.co.in (Bisleri general customer contact, not personal)

notes: Private company; no personal social accounts found. Best route is Bisleri corporate communications. Biography source: https://www.afaqs.com/39024_ramesh-j-chauhan-unveils-his-biography

name: Nawal Kishore Singh
current_role: Chairman & Managing Director (CMD), Galpha Laboratories Ltd (Mumbai); Alkem Laboratories promoter-group shareholder
profile: Son of Alkem Laboratories founder Samprada Singh and part of Alkem's promoter family; he served on Alkem's board until 2015 and still holds a small promoter stake (~1% in 2024). He runs Galpha Laboratories, a pharma formulations maker that became independent of the Alkem group in 1986, with plants in Baddi and Ankleshwar and exports to 23 countries.
interesting_fact: Galpha says it exports more than 100 pharmaceutical brands to 23 countries; in his CMD message he calls the company 'an extended family of mine' built to provide quality medicines at an affordable price.

name: Suryarao Yarlagadda
current_role: Founder & Managing Director, Devi Fisheries Ltd (Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh)
profile: Andhra Pradesh seafood entrepreneur (Yarlagadda Surya Rao) who founded Devi Fisheries, incorporated in 1997, now a vertically integrated frozen-shrimp exporter employing 6,000+ people, with sister businesses Devi Aqua Feeds and US arm Devi Fisheries Inc. Devi is among India's largest shrimp exporters.
